The AIDT shall comprise; - Architecture including Conservation Architect, Assigned Certifier, PSDP and any other associated specialist design services required by the Scope of Services as per Schedule B - Civil and Structural Engineering - Mechanical/ Plant Engineering, - Electrical Engineering - Fire / DAC Consultancy Services The procurement is for a single coordinated AIDT Tender.
